sacredAudio.title: Sacred Frequencies & Celestial Harmonics
sacredAudio.scienceText1: The 432 Hz frequency is known in sacred acoustic science as the natural tuning of the Universe. Unlike the modern 440 Hz standard (imposed in the 20th century), 432 Hz mathematically aligns with the golden ratio, human geometry, and celestial mechanics.
sacredAudio.schumannBullet: 8 Hz (Schumann Resonance): Earth's fundamental electromagnetic resonance frequency.
sacredAudio.earthMultipleBullet: 432 Hz = 8 Hz x 54: Exact multiple of Earth's heartbeat.
sacredAudio.scienceTitle2: Resonance with Body Water & the Moon
sacredAudio.scienceText2: The human body is made of over 70% water. Just as the Moon exerts gravitational pull on ocean tides, 432 Hz structures cellular water into perfect geometry. During Dhikr, Tasbih, and meditation, this vibration calms the heart rate, reduces cortisol, and induces deep tranquility (Sakinah).
sacredAudio.scienceTitle3: Science of Sounds & Celestial Spheres (Ilm al-Aflak)
sacredAudio.scienceText3: Great scholars and mystics (such as Al-Farabi in Kitab al-Musiqa al-Kabir and the Ikhwan al-Safa) taught that the 7 musical notes correspond to the 7 classical planets and the 28 Lunar Mansions (Manazil al-Qamar). Reciting Divine Names in resonance with the day's planetary frequency harmonizes the mind with the cosmic symphony of the Supreme Creator.
